codeReview.summary: The fix addresses the original regression where narrowing removed unrelated goal cards entirely, but it still leaves a correctness gap: when the active scope remains set and additional filters narrow that scoped subset to zero rows, the now-empty scoped goal card stays interactive. That violates the feature intent that empty goals render with empty-goal treatment and remain non-scopable under narrowed states.

issues.description: renderGoals marks a card interactive whenever it is currently scoped (`const isInteractive = isScoped || isScopable`). If a user scopes to a goal and then adds filters/search that remove every row from that goal, the card renders as empty (`0 / 0`, no active rows) but still keeps its click handler and `aria-disabled="false"` because `isScoped` is still true. The feature explicitly requires goals with zero rows in the active subset to remain non-scopable, so this scoped-empty state still violates the fix contract and the prior failure is only partially resolved.

summary: Fail: the commit restores the full goal-card frame under narrowing, but an empty goal card can still remain interactive when it is the active scope and later filters/search reduce that scoped subset to zero rows.
